claim: In a layout's image use, tail[0] tiles the art over the use's rect (else it stretches), tail[1] and tail[2] mirror it on x and y; tail[3] (9-slice slot) and tail[7], tail[8] (stretch with the component) are as in Empire. A use whose image path is empty draws a flat rect in the use's ARGB colour. Ten composites drawn on this rule match their live shots by eye (run 20261106_j99pc)
notes: the atlas keeps art ids per state, not these fields: a reader that draws must parse the layout (uikit/napoleon/vanilla/gallery.py); the tile reading rests on the look of tiled fills, not on an engine read
